## Log

The purpose of this script is to evaluate and compare revised BayWatch monitoring locations provided by Phil Maxwell from Baywatch. Compare revised sites to monitoring locations from FDEP WINS downloaded by Ryann Rossi. Can I get any metadata for Stations-Station Info.csv? Have 68 obs by 16 variables.

```{r data}
rev_station_ds1 <- read_csv("data/Stations-Station Info Export.csv")
names(rev_station_ds1)
head(rev_station_ds1)
rev_station_ds1 <- clean_names(rev_station_ds1)
# spec(np_ds1)
# names(np_ds1)



# filter(dg_sf1, (!is.na(log_n2o))

summary(rev_station_ds1$latitude) #returns no NA
summary(rev_station_ds1$longitude) #returns no NA

unique(rev_station_ds1$number)
distinct(rev_station_ds1,win_location_id) %>%  dplyr::arrange(., win_location_id) %>% print(n=Inf)
# 68 distinct win_location_id entries
distinct(rev_station_ds1, number) %>% dplyr::arrange(., number) %>% print(n=Inf)
# 130 distinct number entries


```

## Create SF object
Revised locations outside of sf_bbl2 polygon include points in Lakes Powell, Lullwater, and Martin.

```{r, create_sf}
# create sf object
coords <- data.frame(longitude  = rev_station_ds1$longitude, latitude = rev_station_ds1$latitude)
head(coords)

# See Marc Weber workshop above about Coordinate Reference Systems (CRS)

rev_station_sf1 <- st_as_sf(rev_station_ds1, coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs =4269) %>% st_transform((5070))

class(rev_station_sf1)

st_crs(rev_station_sf1) == st_crs(sf_bbl2)
st_crs(sf_bbl2)
rev_station_sf1 <- rev_station_sf1 %>% st_transform(3087)
st_crs(rev_station_sf1) == st_crs(sf_bbl2)

mapview(rev_station_sf1) + mapview(sf_bbl2)


# mapview(hab_sf1, zcol = "Depth", cex = "Depth", alpha.regions = .8, legend = TRUE, popup = popupTable(hab_sf1, zcol = c("Depth", "Site"))) + mapview(bigbend_seagrass)

# index more spatially extensive sf object against small spatial extent results in a clip
# now have 53 entries
rev_station_sf2 <- rev_station_sf1[sf_bbl2, ]

# I believe my linked micromaps are based on 58 stations
mapview(rev_station_sf2)
```
